scope: one real Telegram Bot private chat discovered through resident Gateway pairing, native DSH reply, duplicate-update suppression, one-shot native Approval, clean Host restart without re-pairing, uninstall, and native Session readback; not group policy, media, webhook mode, long-term soak, or Hermes paired evidence

platform.transport: official Telegram Bot API long polling
platform.route: one Bot account plus a direct principal discovered by unknown DM, approved by the Host, and bound to one native Workspace and Session
platform.model: keyless deterministic DSH fixture so this epoch isolates real channel and lifecycle effects

hardGates: explicit real-platform approval exists before the Bot token is read
the EvoForge and DSH worktrees are clean and DSH is the frozen buildable support revision
the latest DSH revision is separately recorded and its upstream build status is not hidden
final dsh-gateway and dsh-telegram tarballs install into a clean DSH web profile and dump their intended Bundle rows
the official Telegram transport reaches ready with zero pre-authorized Telegram routes
an unknown private message produces a short-lived code before Agent dispatch and Host approval creates one dynamic trust grant without profile rewrite or reconnect
one human-sent exact challenge after approval enters the native DSH Session and its final answer is durably delivered
the same Telegram update cannot create a second native turn or duplicate external reply
one native DSH Approval request resolves allowed-once and cannot be replaced by a benchmark-owned approval system
a clean Host restart restores the exact grant and a new private message/reply without another pairing ceremony
dispose and official plugin removal succeed, native DSH boots, and the native Session still contains the exact ingress and approval facts
